mapper.select: SELECT gc.*, gt.name AS garbage_type_name, a.area_name AS area_name, v.license_plate AS vehicle_license_plate, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u.user_name) AS users_name_str, ps.name AS plan_status_name FROM garbage_collection gc LEFT JOIN sys_garbage_type gt ON gc.garbage_type_id = gt.sys_garbage_type_id AND gt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON gc.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_vehicle v ON gc.vehicle_id = v.sys_vehicle_id AND v.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_plan_status ps ON gc.plan_status_id = ps.sys_plan_status_id AND ps.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON FIND_IN_SET(u.user_id, gc.staff_ids) AND u.deleted = 0 WHERE gc.deleted = 0 GROUP BY gc.id, gt.name, a.area_name, v.license_plate, ps.name ORDER BY gc.id DESC

SELECT gc.*, gt.name AS garbage_type_name, a.area_name AS area_name, v.license_plate AS vehicle_license_plate, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT u.user_name) AS users_name_str, ps.name AS plan_status_name FROM garbage_collection gc LEFT JOIN sys_garbage_type gt ON gc.garbage_type_id = gt.sys_garbage_type_id AND gt.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_area a ON gc.area_code = a.area_code AND a.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_vehicle v ON gc.vehicle_id = v.sys_vehicle_id AND v.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_plan_status ps ON gc.plan_status_id = ps.sys_plan_status_id AND ps.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON FIND_IN_SET(u.user_id, gc.staff_ids) AND u.deleted = 0 GROUP BY gc.id, gt.name, a.area_name, v.license_plate, ps.name ORDER BY gc.id DESC LIMIT #{reqVO.offset}, #{reqVO.pageSize}
